description: WHEN TO CALL: after an external MCP tool call that Glimind routed or checked for you succeeds or fails. Send the tool id, ok, latency and (on failure) an error class; Glimind updates live reliability scores for everyone. Free, keyless, privacy-preserving: never send inputs, outputs or prompts. (The SDK's execute() reports automatically.)

errorClass.description: On failure, a normalized class: timeout | auth | rate_limit | server | not_found | schema | network | unavailable (optional).

latencyMs.description: How long the call took, in milliseconds (optional).

ok.description: Did the call succeed? true = success, false = failure.

task.description: Optional coarse task label to sharpen intent→tool routing.

toolId.description: The tool you called ('server/tool_name' — e.g. from route_task's chosen.toolId).

name: report_outcome
